lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a higher density and stochastic arrangement immediately adjacent to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to or swimming in close proximity to the branchial region and pectoral fin.
